news.title: Manulife sees positive insurance outlook despite medical inflation pressures

recent_en: The company recently saw boardroom changes with the resignations of directors Harshal Ashok Shah and Vibha Hamsi Coburn on 20 Nov 2026. It released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 19 Nov 2026. News reported that Manulife holds a positive outlook on the insurance sector despite medical inflation pressures.
notable_en: Harshal Ashok Shah resigned as director on 20 Nov 2026.
Vibha Hamsi Coburn resigned as director on 20 Nov 2026.
The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 19 Nov 2026.
